title: Eyelid hygiene for blepharitis
what: This is daily care of the eyelid edges: warm compresses, massage, and cleaning. It eases inflammation and dry eyes.
why: For red and itchy eyelids, crusts on the lashes, or a feeling of sand in the eyes.
duration: usually 5 to 10 minutes a day; improvement comes in a few weeks
tell_doctor: If you have rosacea or skin problems on your face
What drops and medicines you already use

prepare.title: Products
prepare.text: Use the eyelid cleanser your doctor prescribed.

prepare.title: Hands
prepare.text: Wash your hands before you start.

prepare.title: Makeup
prepare.text: Remove your makeup before eyelid care.

bring: The eyelid cleanser your doctor prescribed
steps: Put a warm compress on your closed eyelids for a few minutes
Gently massage the eyelid edges with your fingers
Clean the eyelid edges and lashes with the prescribed product
Use drops or ointment if your doctor prescribed them
feel: At first, it may sting a little
after: Do this every day, even when you feel better
Use a separate wipe for each eye
Come for a checkup if your doctor scheduled one
red_flags: Severe swelling and redness of the eyelid with a fever

faq.q: Can blepharitis be cured for good?
faq.a: It is often a long-term condition. Regular care keeps it under control.
During a flare-up, it is better not to. Ask your doctor.

reminders.text: Remember your eyelid care today: warm compress, massage, cleaning.
